title: Smooth cutoff of the radial form to a bounded test form
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let ω : ℝ^P → Λ_{m+1}(ℝ^P) be any (m+1)-form, let ψ₀ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) be a C^∞ m-form (ContDiff ℝ ∞) with ψ₀(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for all x ∈ ℝ^P and v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m ((x, v) := Fin.cons x v), and let 0 < r < s. Then there is a test form ψ ∈ D^m(ℝ^P) = TestFormOn univ m such that (i) ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for every x in the open ball B_r(0) and every v, and (ii) if covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(y)) ≤ 1 for every y, then covectorEuclideanNorm(ψ(x)) ≤ P^{2m+1}·s for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (ψ₀ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) (r s : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ₀ → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (v : Fin m → Eucl P), ψ₀ x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * ω (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → 0 < r → r < s → ∃ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m, (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Eucl P) r, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * ω (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) ∧ ((∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω y) ≤ 1) → ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x) ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ (2 * m + 1) * s)
